title: World Cup: ATFrenchies share their France-Morocco predictions
summary: ⚽ 🏆 Alexandre Durand and Tom Carles, the duo that make up AT Frenchies, are showing their support for France's #LesBleus as they face #Morocco in the first quarter final at the FIFA World Cup. 🇫🇷 🇲🇦 Who do they think will win? They share their analysis with FRANCE 24 ▶️
